thread:
Maya: Heads-up: found inconsistent terming across docs + SDKs around the feature that pins models. Some pages say `model lock`, others `pinned model`, some code uses `pinModel`/`pin_model`. Need a quick decision so the migration PRs don't diverge. cc @Liam @Sophia @Jordan
Liam: quick read: glossary currently has `pinned model` (two words). SDK examples lean `pinModel`. Ops docs used `model lock`. messy.
Sophia: I think we should pick one canonical glossary term and map others as redirects/aliases. Suggest `model pinning` as the canonical noun. It's explicit and matches product language (pin/ unpin).
Alex: Strong +1 for `model pinning`. For UI and examples use imperative verbs: `Pin model` / `Unpin model`. For code keys: camelCase in JS (`pinModel`), snake_case in config/YAML (`pin_model`). Add a short note in the style guide.
Jordan: Agree on `model pinning`. Also: search will break if we leave mixed forms. We should add a small grep-based linter to docs CI to flag any of the variants until migration completes. I can take that on.
docs-bot: PR #501 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 — initial glossary update and one example snippet added.
Maya: Thanks. Two pragmatic questions: 1) exact glossary sentence so Lauren can sign off, 2) sample before/after snippets for migration guide.
Sophia: Draft glossary entry: "model pinning — the practice of locking a specific model version for a route or deployment to ensure consistent inference results and prevent regressions during model upgrades." Keeps it short.
Maya: Nice. Add a short "why" sentence: "Useful for deterministic behavior in production and to avoid unexpected regressions"
Alex: Snippet examples: current mixed JS example:
```js
// current (mixed)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', pin_model: true });
```
Recommended JS example (camelCase):
```js
// recommended (JS)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', pinModel: true });
```
YAML/server example (snake_case):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: inference
    model: redwood-7b
    pin_model: true
```
Jordan: For migration I propose: 1) add glossary commit, 2) run automated replace in examples only (not prose), 3) open PR for style-guide notes, 4) add docs CI linter to block new mixed uses. I'll prep the CI job.
Liam: Regex I'll use for grep: `(?i)\\b(pin\s?model|model\s?pinning|pin_model|pinModel|pinned model|model lock)\\b`. I'll export matches and we can triage.
Maya: Ownership: Sophia finishes glossary and ping Lauren for sign-off. Alex updates style guide and adds the code-key casing rule. Liam does the grep + branch for example-only edits. Jordan adds the CI lint. Timeline: PRs by Thursday EOD?
Sophia: I can get the glossary PR up tomorrow morning.
Alex: I'll update style guide and include a short rationale paragraph.
Liam: I'll start the grep today and push a branch with proposed example changes.
Jordan: CI job sketched, will open a PR to add it to docs-ci.
Maya: Cool — once PRs are open I'll add a line to the docs migration checklist and post a short blurb in #announcements so folks know about the temporary lint.
Sophia: Also propose we add a small note in the changelog for the SDK deprecations (if we rename any public config keys).
Alex: Good call. If any public SDK key changes are required we need a deprecation path. But I think sticking to showing camelCase for JS and leaving server config as-is avoids breaking API.
Maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in #docs on Friday for PR reviews. :thumbsup:
